These activities may be considered “sales” or “sharing” of your personal information for “cross-context behavioral advertising,” or “processing” of your personal information for “targeted advertising.” Depending on how you interact with us, the information we process for these activities may be associated with your device or browser, or with your email address (if you have provided it to us). Instructions on how to opt-out from both email and device-based activities are below: Email Address To exercise your opt-out rights (as described above) in connection with the email address you provided to us (such as through account registration, newsletters or marketing subscriptions) please submit your request here. Device Information To opt out of our use of personal information associated with a device that may be considered “sales,” “sharing for cross-context behavioral advertising” or “targeted advertising” move the toggle to the left and go to the bottom of this pop-up and click “Save Settings.” If you close this pop-up without clicking “Save Settings,” any opt-out settings you have chosen will not be saved. Your choices will apply to all devices accessed with your account if you have an account and are logged in, or to this device only if you are not a logged-in user. You will need to renew this choice in each Paramount Service you visit, if you clear your browser cookies, or if you return to this Paramount Service using a different browser or device and are logged-out user.EssentialThese cookies are essential for the proper functioning of our Services.
